title: Snapmaker U1 Multi-Toolhead 3D Printer ‐ $1,099 + $8.95 Delivery @ digiDirect
body:
Deal: Snapmaker U1 Multi-Toolhead 3D Printer ‐ $1,099 + $8.95 Delivery @ digiDirect

[onggie] First 3D printer. Thinking of an U1, any must/should haves to buy with this?
[3dprintdeals] filament, lots of PLA in lots of colours
IKEA Samla top hat
cryogrip plate
[3dprintdeals] There are more variants/colours in PLA than PETG
But I do use PETG over PLA when I can
[3dprintdeals] Not essential but helps with warping on large prints and making sure prime tower sticks, especially with mixed material prints
[Franc-T] Look for a filament deal and buy 10+ filaments at a time, you save a lot that way.
Get a range of colours.
PETG or PLA.
[kingmoron] Need a father son combo. Got a creator 5 pro. Should I get a second or this ? I don't see much difference just a larger size on ehw u1 but probably easier for spares having two flashforges
[3dprintdeals] C5P if you already have one so you can share one set of parts and accessories
C5P:
- comes with top lid
- heated chamber and exhaust as stock
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Good price but i refuse to support digidirect anymore
[3dprintdeals] Try price match it, otherwise I feel this will be the BF price starting on 12th
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Did you bother getting the top enclosure? / is it worth it?
[3dprintdeals] I got the IKEA Samla lid, works great
Cuts the noise down a lot.
Alternatively, this folding box from Bunnings also works quite well, but looks to be sold out.
https://www.printables.com/model/1719238-snapmaker-u1-bunnin…
https://www.bunnings.com.au/all-set-medium-folding-storage-b…
[Franc-T] If printing indoors, it has a filter.
I print in my shed so I got the kit from aliexpress (plus when I bought mine it was 8 months for the top cover to be available)
Quite happy with the top.
[3dprintdeals] @Franc-T: Which top kit did you get from ali?
[Franc-T] @3dprintdeals: was named this '…Snapmaker U1 Top Hat Enclosure 3mm thickness PC Panels kit Designed by Srin…'
Aliexpress is down or something at the moment so cant post a direct link.
You need to print the parts if you use it though, this is the clear plastic panels only + some double sided tape
heres the link:
https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005010640661572.html?spm=a2…
$50 shipping is a bit rich though!
[TripleNoodle] Many thanks for posting this deal. Have you, or anyone here, used an enclosed Bambu lab printer (i.e. P2S or X2D) and are able to compare the noise of this with the Samla mod against those?
I'm considering this printer, but noise would be a big concern as I'm in a small apartment. Will probably get an Ikea Platsa cabinet to put this inside as well to minimise noise / VOC.
[3dprintdeals] similar, maybe a little louder when changing toolheads.
[TripleNoodle] Thank you for the reply. Do you think the noise will be excessive if I use this printer for long prints about 3m away from where I spend most of my day?
[3dprintdeals] Depends on how sensitive you are to noise,
I wouldn't want to be working 3m away from any printer, even the quiet A1 Mini.
I put them in far away rooms or garage
You might be ok with noise cancelling earbuds/headphones
[rong] No more open source please, hate being played by the 3d printer.
I would rather pay for Bambu closed source and play the 3d printer.
[3dprintdeals] nothing wrong with the Snapmaker being open source,
They still do their thing with firmware and Snorca, and community still develops their own like PAXX12
[dahoe] This or the bambu x2d? Both have deals on now and well reviewed. My first printer but have been thinking about getting one for years. Plan on printing stuff for the kids which would be more multicoloured, but also functional and decorative stuff around the house and for the bicycle. I’m thinking mostly pla, petg and tpu for now
[hippocrit] Second this, I get paralysed in picking a printer when I read the comment section.
[3dprintdeals] If you have any plan to do lots of multicolour than go U1.
X2D I would pick if doing lots of single filament ABS/ASA, PC, and other engineering filaments.
[NigelTufnel] This. X2D is mainly only better than if you need heated chamber and multi-filament only for support material.
[Vladdo] I have 3x A1s, P2S, Kobra 2 Max and a U1. U1 is a far better printer than the others, by far. I love the open source nature, printing multicolour without penalty, larger bed size. I mostly print in PETG and it's been a pretty good ride.
